request: Analyze, install and apply four SEO/marketing repositories
editorialDecision: Improve discovery and transparency for the existing 38 guides rather than create duplicate keyword pages. No new blog articles in this change.

findings.finding: Archive groups posts chronologically without a complete topic directory
findings.action: Add crawlable topic directory on blog page one, with every guide and an unmapped-content fallback.

findings.finding: Organization byline leads to homepage; AI disclosure has no detailed policy
findings.action: Add a truthful editorial policy and link from bylines, disclosures and footer.

findings.finding: Modified dates exist in schema but are not visible
findings.action: Display Updated date only when modified differs from first publication.

findings.finding: GEO skill incorrectly equates GPTBot with ChatGPT Search
findings.action: Document official crawler correction in adapters and project workflow; keep existing allow-all robots policy.

metrics.reason: No metrics provider or new Search Console performance measurement used in this implementation.

validation.content: Passed against starting commit; 38 articles, zero new articles today.
validation.productionBuild: Passed with Next.js Webpack; local Turbopack worker port binding was denied even on escalated retry. Deployment uses normal Turbopack build on GitHub.
validation.export: 44 canonical sitemap routes; full exported-link/schema checks and new SEO foundation checks passed.
validation.mobile: 390px: topic directory, editorial page and modified article checked without horizontal overflow; topic jump and editorial links worked. Both app buttons opened coming-soon dialog; Escape restored Google Play focus.
validation.deployment: Pending commit and GitHub Actions verification.
